info.title: What a qualification measures and records

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_DIMENSIONS.description: The measurable dimensions a measurement document declares it covers: latency and cost since the format's 1.0, stability, RT safety and features since 1.1, for the hosting verdict.

oneOf.title: latency
oneOf.x-text: How long a plugin takes to produce its first sound after it is driven or played.

oneOf.title: cost
oneOf.x-text: How much CPU time a plugin spends per block under a sustained stimulus.

oneOf.title: stability
oneOf.x-text: Whether a plugin instantiates, processes and tears down without crashing or producing non-finite output.

oneOf.title: rtSafety
oneOf.x-text: Whether a plugin's audio thread avoids locks, allocation and other calls a real-time thread must not make.

oneOf.title: features
oneOf.x-text: What capabilities a plugin declares and a prober can confirm, beside latency, cost, stability and RT safety.

oneOf.title: memory
oneOf.description: How much memory a plugin holds at rest and per instance.
oneOf.x-text: How much memory a plugin holds at rest and per instance.

oneOf.title: hostAdmission
oneOf.description: Whether the host admitted the plugin and its cells.
oneOf.x-text: Whether the host admitted the plugin and its cells.

oneOf.title: memoryGrowth
oneOf.description: How the memory of a plugin grows over a long run.
oneOf.x-text: How the memory of a plugin grows over a long run.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_UNMEASURED_KIN.description: What an absent figure means for a merge, the one distinction that changes behaviour: a property of the plugin, a failure of this run, or a dimension the run did not cover.

oneOf.title: nothingToMeasure
oneOf.description: A property of the plugin: any prober on any machine reaches it, so it may override a figure.
oneOf.x-text: A property of the plugin: any prober on any machine reaches it, so it may override a figure.

oneOf.title: probeFailed
oneOf.description: A property of this run: it says nothing about the plugin and never overrides a figure.
oneOf.x-text: A property of this run: it says nothing about the plugin and never overrides a figure.

oneOf.title: notAttempted
oneOf.description: The run did not cover this plugin or this dimension: a partial run, not a finding.
oneOf.x-text: The run did not cover this plugin or this dimension: a partial run, not a finding.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_UNMEASURED_REA.description: Every reason a figure may be absent, each of its kind: an outcome a sweep produced, never a hypothetical. A reader that meets a reason it does not know treats it as probe-failed.

oneOf.title: noAudioIn
oneOf.description: No audio input port: nothing to drive.
oneOf.x-text: No audio input port: nothing to drive.

oneOf.title: noAudioOut
oneOf.description: No audio output port: nothing to read.
oneOf.x-text: No audio output port: nothing to read.

oneOf.title: silentOutput
oneOf.description: Driven, and silent under a stimulus that should have passed.
oneOf.x-text: Driven, and silent under a stimulus that should have passed.

oneOf.title: needsCarrier
oneOf.description: Needs a second audio input the prober did not supply.
oneOf.x-text: Needs a second audio input the prober did not supply.

oneOf.title: needsImpulseResponse
oneOf.description: A convolver needing an impulse response the prober did not load.
oneOf.x-text: A convolver needing an impulse response the prober did not load.

oneOf.title: needsContent
oneOf.description: An instrument that is silent under notes until a sample, a sound font or an instrument file is loaded, which the prober did not load.
oneOf.x-text: An instrument that is silent under notes until a sample, a sound font or an instrument file is loaded, which the prober did not load.

oneOf.title: unpinnable
oneOf.description: The files the host loads cannot be pinned.
oneOf.x-text: The files the host loads cannot be pinned.

oneOf.title: noVoices
oneOf.description: An instrument whose voice-info declares a capacity of 0.
oneOf.x-text: An instrument whose voice-info declares a capacity of 0.

oneOf.title: notesUnplayable
oneOf.description: An instrument whose note input reads no dialect the prober speaks.
oneOf.x-text: An instrument whose note input reads no dialect the prober speaks.

oneOf.title: voicesUnknown
oneOf.description: An instrument that declares no voice capacity, run with no probe count.
oneOf.x-text: An instrument that declares no voice capacity, run with no probe count.

oneOf.title: refusedInstantiation
oneOf.description: The plugin would not instantiate at this rate or block size.
oneOf.x-text: The plugin would not instantiate at this rate or block size.

oneOf.title: probeCrashed
oneOf.description: The probe worker died while hosting the plugin.
oneOf.x-text: The probe worker died while hosting the plugin.

oneOf.title: probeTimeout
oneOf.description: The probe passed its per-plugin time limit.
oneOf.x-text: The probe passed its per-plugin time limit.

oneOf.title: nonFiniteOutput
oneOf.description: The output held NaN or infinity.
oneOf.x-text: The output held NaN or infinity.

oneOf.title: notInstalled
oneOf.description: The plugin is not installed on this machine.
oneOf.x-text: The plugin is not installed on this machine.

oneOf.title: workerNonconforming
oneOf.description: An LV2 worker interface with work or work_response NULL.
oneOf.x-text: An LV2 worker interface with work or work_response NULL.

oneOf.title: probeError
oneOf.description: A failure with no more specific reason; its own words are kept beside it.
oneOf.x-text: A failure with no more specific reason; its own words are kept beside it.

oneOf.title: notAttempted
oneOf.description: The run did not cover this plugin for this dimension.
oneOf.x-text: The run did not cover this plugin for this dimension.

oneOf.title: memoryBound
oneOf.description: A measurement pass did not fit the memory bound the run set: that pass alone is unmeasured, and the passes after it are measured.
oneOf.x-text: A measurement pass did not fit the memory bound the run set: that pass alone is unmeasured, and the passes after it are measured.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_METHOD.description: How a latency figure was taken. note-onset is an instrument's: a held note's first sound.

oneOf.title: impulseOnset
oneOf.description: The delay from a unit impulse to the first output sample above the residual floor: what the plugin does.
oneOf.x-text: The delay from a unit impulse to the first output sample above the residual floor: what the plugin does.

oneOf.title: declaredPort
oneOf.description: Read from the plugin's own latency report: what it claims.
oneOf.x-text: Read from the plugin's own latency report: what it claims.

oneOf.title: noteOnset
oneOf.description: The delay from a note on to the first output sample above the floor.
oneOf.x-text: The delay from a note on to the first output sample above the floor.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_COST_METHODS.description: How a cost figure was taken.

oneOf.title: blockTimePercentile
oneOf.description: A percentile of per-block wall time under a sustained stimulus, warm-up discarded, in nanoseconds per sample.
oneOf.x-text: A percentile of per-block wall time under a sustained stimulus, warm-up discarded, in nanoseconds per sample.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_SCALIN.description: How latency moves with the sample rate, derived from readings at several rates, never assumed from a plugin's name.

oneOf.title: fixedFrame
oneOf.description: The same frame count at every rate.
oneOf.x-text: The same frame count at every rate.

oneOf.title: fixedTime
oneOf.description: The same milliseconds at every rate.
oneOf.x-text: The same milliseconds at every rate.

oneOf.title: zero
oneOf.description: No latency a mix can notice at any measured rate.
oneOf.x-text: No latency a mix can notice at any measured rate.

oneOf.title: nonconforming
oneOf.description: Fits neither law at a magnitude that reaches a mix: flagged, never averaged.
oneOf.x-text: Fits neither law at a magnitude that reaches a mix: flagged, never averaged.

oneOf.title: singleRate
oneOf.description: One usable reading: no law can be fitted.
oneOf.x-text: One usable reading: no law can be fitted.

oneOf.title: unmeasured
oneOf.description: No rate produced a figure.
oneOf.x-text: No rate produced a figure.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_SCALIN.description: Why a derived scaling class is not the naive fit over every reading.

oneOf.title: belowBudget
oneOf.description: The readings fit no law but every one is inside the latency budget: the detector's noise.
oneOf.x-text: The readings fit no law but every one is inside the latency budget: the detector's noise.

oneOf.title: informationalRate
oneOf.description: Only a reading below the operational rates breaks the law; it stays as information.
oneOf.x-text: Only a reading below the operational rates breaks the law; it stays as information.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_LATENCY_EXCLUS.description: Why one rate's reading was left out of the fit and of every rate resolution.

oneOf.title: impossibleZero
oneOf.description: Zero frames at this rate while another rate measured non-zero.
oneOf.x-text: Zero frames at this rate while another rate measured non-zero.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_VOICE_BASES.description: Where the number of notes an instrument's cost was measured with came from: the voice capacity the plugin declares (CLAP voice-info), or a count the caller gave.

oneOf.title: declared
oneOf.x-text: The voice capacity the plugin declares through CLAP's voice-info extension.

oneOf.title: probe
oneOf.x-text: A note count the caller gave the prober, not read from the plugin.

QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_VERDICT_RATING.description: The four ratings a verdict speaks, in order from the best.

oneOf.title: suitable
oneOf.x-text: The plugin meets the host profile's budget on every measured dimension.

oneOf.title: conditional
oneOf.x-text: The plugin meets the host profile's budget only under a stated condition.

oneOf.title: unknown
oneOf.x-text: Not enough was measured to rate the plugin against the host profile.

oneOf.title: unsuitable
oneOf.x-text: The plugin does not meet the host profile's budget on at least one measured dimension.

QUALIFICATION_RESOURCE_MEMORY_PHASES.description: When a plugin's memory is read, per instance (plugin-qualify#114): after instantiate, after activate, at rest after processing, with notes held, and for a second instance, so a shared one-time load is told apart from the per-instance cost.

oneOf.title: afterInstantiate
oneOf.x-text: Memory read right after the plugin instantiates.

oneOf.title: afterActivate
oneOf.x-text: Memory read right after the plugin activates.

oneOf.title: atRest
oneOf.x-text: Memory read at rest, after processing, with no note playing.

oneOf.title: notesHeld
oneOf.x-text: Memory read while notes are held.

oneOf.title: secondInstance
oneOf.x-text: Memory read for a second instance, so a shared one-time load is told apart from the per-instance cost.

QUALIFICATION_RESOURCE_UNMEASURED_REASON.description: Why a resource has no figure a host profile can read, beside the measurement's own reasons (QUALIFICATION_MEASUREMENT_UNMEASURED_REASONS).

oneOf.title: unmeasuredOnClass
oneOf.description: The only figure was taken on another machine class: never read as a pass, never scaled.
oneOf.x-text: The only figure was taken on another machine class: never read as a pass, never scaled.

oneOf.title: limitExceeded
oneOf.description: The run hit the limit probe isolation set for the resource; the limit is recorded beside it.
oneOf.x-text: The run hit the limit probe isolation set for the resource; the limit is recorded beside it.

QUALIFICATION_RESOURCE_BUDGET_SCOPES.description: What a host profile's budget for a resource is counted over (plugin-qualify#114, #115): one plugin instance, or the whole console.

oneOf.title: perInstance
oneOf.x-text: Counted over one plugin instance.

oneOf.title: perConsole
oneOf.x-text: Counted over the whole console.

QUALIFICATION_RESOURCE_HOST_ISOLATIONS.description: How a host runs its plugins.

oneOf.title: inProcess
oneOf.x-text: The host runs its plugins in its own process.

oneOf.title: perProcess
oneOf.x-text: The host runs each plugin in its own process.

oneOf.title: sharedProcess
oneOf.x-text: The host runs its plugins together in one process apart from its own.

QUALIFICATION_RESOURCE_HOST_LATENCY_HAND.description: Whether a host aligns on a plugin's reported latency or only passes it on.

oneOf.title: compensated
oneOf.x-text: The host delays every other path to align on this plugin's reported latency.

oneOf.title: uncompensated
oneOf.x-text: The host passes the plugin's reported latency on, without aligning other paths to it.

QUALIFICATION_RESOURCE_THREAD_SCHEDULING.description: The scheduling class a host gives its plugin's threads, as the probe output records it.

oneOf.title: none
oneOf.x-text: No particular scheduling class: the thread runs as any other.

oneOf.title: fifo
oneOf.x-text: The real-time FIFO scheduling class.
